clips.title: The story
paras: At Dun Baldar, Vanndar Stormpike leads the Stormpike Expedition into Alterac Valley. He searches its frozen peaks for ancient relics and raw resources, waging an unyielding Alliance war against the Frostwolf orcs.

Vanndar Stormpike leads the dwarven excavation into Alterac Valley as a veteran mountain king of Ironforge. After the Third War, he marched the Stormpike Guard into the northern mountains to seek hidden mineral riches and long-lost titan artifacts. He made Dun Baldar his fortified base, claiming the valley as ancestral ground and rightful Alliance territory. From there, he directs military outposts, defensive bunkers, and frontline pushes. Vanndar is determined that no retreat will ever be sounded under his watch.

Vanndar's mining and prospecting reached into the Frostwolf clan's home, starting a brutal mountain war. The orcs demanded that he withdraw, but he refused to yield an inch, vowing Alterac Valley would belong to the dwarves. From his throne room deep within Dun Baldar, with marshals and bodyguards at his side, Vanndar oversees the defense against Frostwolf incursions. He also sends Alliance champions to break enemy lines and claim the valley.
